title: Graduate Street and Degree Close, Belhar: off-duty police constable shot dead, 11 Nov
summary: An off-duty 28-year-old constable from the Belhar Crime Prevention Unit was shot dead by unknown suspects at the corner of Graduate Street and Degree Close, Belhar, at about 00:50 on Wednesday 11 November, Western Cape p...
story: An off-duty 28-year-old constable from the Belhar Crime Prevention Unit was shot dead by unknown suspects at the corner of Graduate Street and Degree Close, Belhar, at about 00:50 on Wednesday 11 November, Western Cape police spokesperson Constable Ndakhe Gwala confirmed to IOL and Smile 90.4FM. Smile 90.4FM reports the shooting happened during a suspected hijacking; police did not state a motive. A murder case was opened and handed to the Hawks, who said no arrests had been made. The map point is the Belhar suburb point, not the street corner.
incident: Wed 11 Nov 2026, about 00:50 (SAPS, via IOL and Smile 90.4FM)
